mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently a warm eighty-six degrees with mainly clear skies, making it a perfect evening for a walk on the Military Ridge State Trail. Tonight, expect a beautiful waxing crescent moon and a spectacular five-minute sighting of the International Space Station starting at ten nineteen PM.

The City of Verona is highlighting several sustainability programs, including home composting drop-offs at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue. Residents can also take advantage of Dane County's Solar Group Buy programs to save on solar installations, and request rebates for installing water-saving rain barrels and energy-efficient toilets.

For upcoming events, this Saturday, July eighteenth, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Louie, or explore the Mount Horeb Art Fair. Looking ahead, mark your calendars for the big Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, July twenty-second at Hometown Junction Park.

In police news, on Friday, July tenth, officers and K9 Drea responded to two separate traffic stops where the drug-detection dog successfully alerted officers to marijuana and drug paraphernalia, leading to multiple citations.
End your day on a sweet note with today's Culver's Flavor of the Day, Mint Cookie. The store will remain open until ten thirty PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to drive over and grab a scoop.
